series.name: 2021 AUX outdoor 3-LED indicator patterns (24 symbol patterns)
series.notes: Outdoor 3-LED indicator map from the 2021 AUX troubleshooting guide — 24 on/off flash symbol patterns (★/●/○). High (service manual). LED blink display — kept separate from alphanumeric codes.

meaning.en: The power module shut the compressor down for overcurrent, overvoltage or overheating.
meaning.ur: Power module ne overcurrent, overvoltage ya overheating ki wajah se compressor band kar diya.

causes.en: Supply voltage out of range or bad compressor/reactor wiring
causes.ur: Supply voltage out-of-range hai ya compressor/reactor wiring kharab hai

causes.en: Module panel, outdoor main panel or compressor failed
causes.ur: Module panel, outdoor main panel ya compressor fail ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Check supply voltage and compressor wiring first
solutions.ur: Pehle supply voltage aur compressor wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the module panel only after system blockage and compressor have been excluded
solutions.ur: Sirf us waqt module panel badlein jab system blockage aur compressor baahar kar diye gaye hon.

meaning.en: The power-factor-correction stage shut down after seeing overcurrent or overvoltage.
meaning.ur: Power factor correction stage ne overcurrent ya overvoltage dekh kar band kar diya.

causes.en: Supply voltage outside the working window
causes.ur: Supply voltage working window se bahar hai

causes.en: Reactor, PFC board or module panel damaged
causes.ur: Reactor, PFC board ya module panel kharab hain

solutions.en: Measure mains voltage and the DC bus before changing parts
solutions.ur: Parts badalne se pehle mains voltage aur DC bus measure karein.

solutions.en: Test the reactor and PFC/module boards
solutions.ur: Reactor aur PFC/module boards test karein.

meaning.ur: Drive compressor ke rotor ko hukm di gayi position ke saath match nahi rakh saka.

causes.ur: Compressor phase wires ghalat order mein hain ya compressor jam ho gaya hai

causes.ur: System blockage hai, module panel ya outdoor panel kharab hai

solutions.en: Try swapping the compressor phase wires
solutions.ur: Compressor phase wires swap karke dekhein.

solutions.en: Check system pressure, then the module panel and compressor

meaning.en: The link between indoor and outdoor units is down - wire, panels or module.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit ke darmiyan link toot gaya hai - wire, panel ya module.

causes.en: Connection wire damaged or loose, or polarity reversed
causes.ur: Connection wire kharab ya dheela hai, ya polarity ulta hai

causes.en: Indoor panel, outdoor panel or module panel failed
causes.ur: Indoor panel, outdoor panel ya module panel fail ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Check the inter-unit cable and confirm correct polarity
solutions.ur: Inter-unit cable check karein aur sahi polarity confirm karein.

solutions.en: Substitute a known-good panel to isolate the failed side
solutions.ur: Known-good panel lagakar pata karein ke kaun si side fail hui.

title.en: Other errors shown on the controller display
title.ur: Controller display par nazar aane wali doosri kharabiyan

meaning.en: Not a fault itself - it means the fault is not one of the three-LED cases and must be read off the wired controller or tooling display.
meaning.ur: Yeh khud koi kharabi nahi - is ka matlab hai ke kharabi teen LED wale cases mein se nahi hai, aur ise wired controller ya tooling display se dekh kar pata karna hoga.

causes.en: A fault code exists that this map does not cover
causes.ur: Koi aisa fault code hai jo is map par cover nahi hai

causes.en: Outdoor unit is running normally and the controller holds the actual message
causes.ur: Outdoor unit normally chal rahi hai aur controller ke paas asal message hai

solutions.en: Read the code from the wired controller or tooling display and look it up in the E/F/P tables
solutions.ur: Code wired controller ya tooling display parh lein aur usse E/F/P tables mein dhoondein.

solutions.en: If no code is shown, treat the unit as normal
solutions.ur: Agar koi code na dikhe to unit ko normal samajhein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED1 off, LED2 flashing, LED3 off

meaning.en: The compressor top-head temperature protection switch is open, so the board assumes the compressor overheated.
meaning.ur: Compressor ke top-head temperature protection switch khul gaya hai, is liye board ko lagta hai ke compressor zyada garam ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Compressor actually overheated, often from low charge or poor heat rejection
causes.ur: Compressor waqai overheat ho gaya hai, aksar kam charge ya kharab heat rejection ki wajah se

causes.en: Failed top-head switch or its wiring
causes.ur: Top-head switch fail ho gaya ya uski wiring kharab hai

solutions.en: Check charge and condenser condition first
solutions.ur: Pehle charge aur condenser ki haalat check karein.

solutions.en: Verify switch continuity against temperature and replace it if it is open when cold
solutions.ur: Temperature ke sath switch ki continuity verify karein aur agar sardi mein open ho to switch badal dein.

causes.en: Recirculated sensor failed or disconnected
causes.ur: Recirculated sensor fail ho gaya ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Four-way valve switch fault or outdoor panel fault
causes.ur: Four-way valve switch fault hai ya outdoor panel ka fault hai

solutions.en: Check the sensor and its wiring up to the outdoor panel
solutions.ur: Sensor aur outdoor panel tak uski wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the four-way valve if the sensor tests good
solutions.ur: Agar sensor test mein theek aaye to four-way valve check karein.

meaning.ur: Drive ne compressor ki limit bana di kyunke jo power mangi gayi thi wo ceiling se zyada thi.

causes.ur: Supply voltage kam hai, jis ki wajah se same output ke liye zyada current le raha hai

causes.en: Module panel or outdoor main control panel fault
causes.ur: Module panel ya outdoor main control panel ka fault hai

solutions.ur: Module panel aur outdoor main panel test karein.

meaning.en: The controller measured current above the protection threshold and reduced the compressor frequency.
meaning.ur: Controller ne current protection threshold se zyada parha aur compressor ki frequency kam kar di.

causes.en: Supply voltage low or unstable under load
causes.ur: Load ke waqt supply voltage kam ya unstable hai

causes.en: System pressure abnormal, or module panel / outdoor panel fault
causes.ur: System pressure abnormal hai, ya module panel / outdoor panel ka fault hai

solutions.en: Measure supply voltage under load before changing parts
solutions.ur: Parts badalne se pehle load ke waqt supply voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Have system pressure and the outdoor controller checked
solutions.ur: System pressure aur outdoor controller check karwaein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED1 off, LED2 off, LED3 flashing

meaning.en: A second blink pattern whose label repeats the exhaust sensor fault - the manual does not disambiguate it from F4.
meaning.ur: Dusra blink pattern jiska label dobara exhaust sensor ki kharabi batata hai - manual ise F4 se alag nahi karta.

causes.en: Exhaust sensor or its wiring genuinely faulty
causes.ur: Exhaust sensor ya uski wiring waqai kharab hai

causes.en: Alternatively the exhaust temperature protection case (P5) - unresolved in this source
causes.ur: Ya phir yeh exhaust temperature protection case (P5) hai - is source par yeh hal nahi hua

solutions.en: Measure the exhaust sensor and its wiring either way
solutions.ur: Chahe jo bhi ho, exhaust sensor aur uski wiring measure kar lein.

solutions.en: Treat the two exhaust patterns as one until a second source confirms the split
solutions.ur: Jab tak doosra source split confirm na kare, dono exhaust patterns ko ek hi samajhein.

causes.ur: Condenser ganda ya block hai, outdoor fan kamzor hai ya capillary restricted hai

causes.en: Outdoor coil sensor or outdoor controller faulty
causes.ur: Outdoor coil sensor ya outdoor controller kharab hai

solutions.en: Wash the condenser and confirm the outdoor fan runs at full speed
solutions.ur: Condenser dhoyein aur confirm karein ke outdoor fan full speed par chal raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the outdoor coil sensor reading
solutions.ur: Outdoor coil sensor ki reading check karein.

causes.ur: Filter ganda hone ya indoor fan block hone se indoor airflow kam ho gayi hai

causes.ur: Indoor coil sensor zyada ki taraf drift kar raha hai

meaning.en: Indoor coil temperature during cooling fell to the freezing threshold.
meaning.ur: Cooling ke doran indoor coil ki temperature freezing ki had tak gir gayi.

causes.en: Blocked indoor air path, clogged filter or stalled indoor fan
causes.ur: Indoor air path block hai, filter ganda hai ya indoor fan ruk gaya hai

causes.en: Low refrigerant charge or a faulty indoor coil sensor
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge kam hai ya indoor coil sensor kharab hai

solutions.en: Clean the filters and coil and clear the indoor air path
solutions.ur: Filters aur coil saaf karein aur indoor air path khali karein.

solutions.ur: Agar yeh wapas aaye to charge aur indoor coil sensor check karwaein.

title.ur: Compressor ki shell temperature se protection

meaning.en: Compressor body temperature exceeded the limit - the manual says to diagnose it exactly as the cap sensor fault.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki body temperature had se zyada ho gayi - manual ke mutabiq is ki diagnosis bilkul cap sensor ki kharabi ki tarah karein.

causes.en: Compressor genuinely overheating
causes.ur: Compressor waqai overheat ho raha hai

causes.en: Same root causes as the cap sensor case - low charge, blocked heat exchange
causes.ur: Yeh cap sensor case jaise hi root causes hain - kam charge aur block heat exchange

solutions.en: Follow the cap sensor (F5) inspection path
solutions.ur: Cap sensor (F5) ka inspection path follow karein.

solutions.en: Check charge and heat rejection before replacing parts
solutions.ur: Parts badalne se pehle charge aur heat rejection check karein.
